description: Converts Markdown (GitHub flavour: tables, task lists, fenced code) to an HTML fragment, or to a complete styled HTML page titled after the first heading.

file.description: Read the text from this file instead (UTF-8)

output.description: Default: <file>.html next to a Markdown file; otherwise returned

page.description: A full HTML document with styles (default true)

name: markdown_to_html
title: Markdown to HTML
